name: imports: an import for its effect is sorted
test: pnpm vitest run addons/format-lint/tests/rules.test.mts -t "sorts an import that is there for its effect"

name: imports: a stylesheet through the alias goes with the aliases
test: pnpm vitest run addons/format-lint/tests/rules.test.mts -t "puts a stylesheet reached through the #/ alias"

name: domains: project turns on noPrivateImports
test: pnpm vitest run addons/format-lint/tests/rules.test.mts -t "fails on lint/correctness/noPrivateImports"

name: domains: every domain is named
test: pnpm vitest run addons/format-lint/tests/rules.test.mts -t "names every domain itself"

name: starter: its entry file has its imports in the sorted order
test: pnpm vitest run addons/format-lint/tests/addon.test.mts -t "finds nothing in a project made from the starter"

name: visual host: its stylesheets are in their groups
test: pnpm vitest run addons/format-lint/tests/addon.test.mts -t "finds nothing in what the visual add-on"
